source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 20 martie — «Sfântul Ierarh Nichita Mărturisitorul, Episcop al Apoloniadei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 20ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Νικήτας ο Ομολογητής επίσκοπος Απολλωνιάδος»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page places his see: Apollonias was a city of Bithynia under the metropolis of Nicomedia. It gives no year, so no dates object has been written from it.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
